name: SPI Ethernet Controller Shield
description: Like a robot internet jack! Plugs directly onto Arduino to connect to LAN networks and the web.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a robot internet jack! Plugs directly onto Arduino to connect to LAN networks and the web.
wiringGuidance: Mount shield directly onto the Arduino Uno headers. Connect an RJ45 Ethernet cable to the shield jack and a router.
commonMistakes: Pin conflicts on digital pins 10, 11, 12, 13 (reserved for Ethernet SPI).
Forgetting to initialize with a valid local MAC address.

miniExperiment.title: Local Network Web Ping
miniExperiment.circuit: Mount shield onto Arduino Uno, plug in RJ45 network cable.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Shield obtains an IP address from your local router and prints it in the Serial Monitor.
